'''Kirrir''' was a resident of the [[Myyydril]] village in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] within the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. She worked as a "cantina girl" at the Myyydril's small [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] within their village.
